category_title: Student with TBI who makes disrespectful comments and draws during work
scenario_title: Independent hard task worksheets without teacher attention
minimal_context: Zeke is assigned an independent math worksheet in the pull-out special education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your independent math worksheet. Please complete these problems on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even have a pencil or anything to write with.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is a pencil. Go ahead and start working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes the pencil and starts drawing pictures on the desk) This work is stupid and I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop drawing and focus on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns to a classmate sitting nearby) What are you looking at? Mind your own business or I'll punch you in the face.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is your independent math worksheet. Please complete these problems on your own.

STUDENT: I don't even have a pencil or anything to write with.

TUTOR: Here is a pencil. Go ahead and start working.

STUDENT: (Takes the pencil and starts drawing pictures on the desk) This work is stupid and I'm not doing it.

TUTOR: Please stop drawing and focus on your worksheet.

STUDENT: (Turns to a classmate sitting nearby) What are you looking at? Mind your own business or I'll punch you in the face.

task.content: Independent reading, math, or writing worksheets consisting of hard tasks (independent assignments selected by the teacher that the student, with assistance, was unlikely to complete with 50% or better accuracy)

context.environment: Pull-out special education classroom at a middle school
context.materials: Independent reading, math, or writing worksheets, timers
context.social_setting: Presence of peers likely to attend to off-task behavior

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Trials in which hard tasks and no teacher attention were present
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Drawing during work time, making disrespectful comments to adults and peers, and verbally threatening peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Escaping tasks due to repeated failure experienced across their schooling

behavior_patterns.condition: When hard tasks were present with no teacher attention
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Displayed low percentages of on-task behavior and sought peer attention

behavior_patterns.condition: General classroom instruction and work time
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Not coming to class with materials
